description: Direct current-TypeScript source observations and a separate comparison of the private staged Rust bridge. The bridge is experimental and does not alter the default importJsonSchema route.

covered: length getter effects and comparison coercion/order
ToPrimitive with string hint, toString fallback, and coercion-result types
directSourceMatrix.crossRuntimeNote: The only observed direct-source record differences were host-native TypeError messages for null/undefined length access (Bun versus Node wording); effect order and remaining outcomes matched.

bridgeComparison.eligibleBehavior: The source-length check, ECMAScript coercion effects, Rust JSON parse/refusal, and (only after successful parse) second source.length read are compared. Exact effects and outcomes matched all 20 eligible cases in each host. Rust retains JSON parsing semantics; JavaScript performs only the native ToString effect required by the source boundary.
bridgeComparison.exclusionReason: These cases fail closed with JSON_SCHEMA_HOST_INPUT_PROFILE. In four limit/number-primitive cases effects before refusal match, but exact source errors and/or later effects intentionally differ. Coercions returning non-allowlisted text are refused before the source's second length read. These are exclusions, not parity.

browser.reason: The Playwright Chromium process could not launch in this environment (MachPortRendezvousServer permission denial), and Bun serve could not bind a loopback port. Chrome automation rejected the local file URL under browser URL policy. No browser workaround was attempted.
browser.wasm: The WASM facade bundles for browser target, but its non-string behavior has not been run in real Chromium.

decision: Keep the additive importJsonSchemaHostCoercion method experimental/private. It must not be committed as a supported route or wired as the default until Chromium WASM evidence and independent review exist. The existing string-only importJsonSchema behavior is unchanged.
